gameAssetExplorer.configuration.title: Game Asset Explorer
gameAssetExplorer.configuration.assetDir: Workspace-relative directories to scan recursively for image assets.
gameAssetExplorer.configuration.assetPro: Game genre / Asset Profile used for semantic asset-type classification and filtering.
RPG categories such as Character, Enemy, Item, Equipment, Skill, Map, UI, and Effect.
Action-game categories such as Character, Enemy, Weapon, Projectile, Stage, UI, and Effect.
Visual-novel categories such as Character, Expression, Background, CG, UI, and Effect.
Card-game categories such as Card, Character, Frame, Icon, Effect, and Background.
Use the categories configured in gameAssetExplorer.customAssetTypes.
gameAssetExplorer.configuration.customAs: Asset types available when the active Asset Profile is Custom.
